claims.content: Allows the Customer to place a monetary bid on an auction item via SmartBid or Single Bid options, subject to confirmation and legal binding terms.

goal.raw_text: Allows the Customer to place a monetary bid on an auction item via SmartBid or Single Bid options, subject to confirmation and legal binding terms.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer must be signed in to the system before placing a bid; if not signed in, the system redirects the bidder to the sign-in page.
The Customer must have the required minimum information required to bid; if not, the system returns the bidder to the product details page after obtaining the information.

The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button, enters an amount in the 'SmartBid' field and clicks 'Place SmartBid', or enters an amount in the 'Your Single Bid' field and clicks 'Place Single Bid' on the Product Details Page.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer clicks the 'QuickBid Now' button, enters an amount in the 'SmartBid' field and clicks 'Place SmartBid', or enters an amount in the 'Your Single Bid' field and clicks 'Place Single Bid' on the Product Details Page.

claims.content: The Customer navigates to the Product Details Page for the desired auction item.

The Customer chooses a bidding method: clicking 'QuickBid Now' to place a single bid at the increment, entering a maximum amount in the 'SmartBid' field, or entering an amount in the 'Your Single Bid' field.
If using SmartBid or Single Bid, the Customer clicks the corresponding 'Place SmartBid' or 'Place Single Bid' button.
The system displays a 'Bid Confirmation Pop-up' message detailing the bid amount, type, and payment method, asking for confirmation.
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking the 'Yes, Place SmartBid' (or equivalent confirmation) button in the pop-up.
Upon confirmation, the system processes the bid and the Customer remains on the Product Details Page.
If the Customer clicks the 'CANCEL' button in the 'Bid Confirmation Pop-up', the bid is not placed and the Customer remains on the Product Details Page.
The Customer has entered into a legally binding contract to purchase the item if they become the winning bidder.
If the Customer is the winning bidder, they must pay for the item(s) upon receipt of the 'winning notification' e-mail.
